newsitem.title: ITALY: Fiat April results above April '96 - Romiti.
newsitem.headline: Fiat April results above April '96 - Romiti.

text.p: Fiat chairman Cesare Romiti said the Italian industrial group's April results were "considerably above those in April last year".
Romiti told the annual shareholders' meeting in Fiat's home city that May should also show favourable results on the basis of commercial trends in the car sector.
He gave no figures for April or May but confirmed previous forecasts for the whole of 1997 when Fiat is expected to show sales growth of 15 percent with total turnover of 90 trillion.
Romiti reiterated that in the absence of extraordinary provisions of the degree seen in 1996, the pre-tax profit for this year would not be below that of 1996.
He confirmed the operating result before extraordinary financial and tax components should show improvement although he gave no data.
The improvement should also be reflected in the net financial position, which at the end of the year should be positive, he said.
